explanation: Orientation 1 (Lengthwise): (79 ÷ 24) × (52 ÷ 12) × (55 ÷ 10) = 3 × 4 × 5 = 60 boxes. Orientation 2 (Widthwise): (79 ÷ 12) × (52 ÷ 24) × (55 ÷ 10) = 6 × 2 × 5 = 60 boxes. Maximum boxes packed = 60 boxes. (Note: Theoretical volume allows 78, but physical dimensions restrict it to 60).
